AurelionSol|adc.identity: Area magic damage mage who scales infinitely. His abilities that hit enemies grant him stardust, which permanently upgrades them (passive). Breath of Light (Q) is a channeled breath that deals more damage to a champion every second. Astral Flight (W) lets him fly over terrain (his breath then has no range limit). Singularity (E) slowly pulls enemies toward its center, which executes low-health targets. Falling Star (R) stuns in an area, then becomes The Skies Descend (knock-up and shockwave) once he has enough stardust.
AurelionSol|adc.playstyle: A scaling mage played like an ADC: weak early, he becomes a huge area threat with stardust. You're behind in gold at 15 minutes on average against every common ADC: that's normal, you win later.
AurelionSol|adc.early_game: Farm and survive. Use Singularity (E) on the wave: minions that die inside give stardust. Hit champions with Q when they walk up to last hit to stack stardust without taking risks. Don't force trades against an ADC and their support.
AurelionSol|adc.level_1: Breath of Light (Q) first. Farm and hit your opponent with the breath when they get close.
AurelionSol|adc.level_2: Singularity (E). It pulls enemies in and executes low-health minions: perfect for farming from range and controlling an engage.
AurelionSol|adc.level_3: Astral Flight (W). Your escape and roaming tool. Mostly save it to get away from the enemy support's engages.
AurelionSol|adc.level_6: Falling Star: an area stun. Combo with your support: engage, E to hold them in place, R, then Q. With enough stardust, the star becomes The Skies Descend.
power_spikes: First completed item: steady area damage.
The Skies Descend unlocked: every teamfight becomes dangerous for the enemy.
Late game: stardust stacked up, all your abilities are empowered.
AurelionSol|adc.lane_plan: Farm safely with E and Q, stack stardust and avoid long trades. Let your support handle the lane and keep W to escape. The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) rewards steady farming, even if your early game is quiet.
AurelionSol|adc.trading: Short trade: Q when your opponent comes into range of the minions. All-in (level 6): E to pull, R to stun, Q to finish. Give up on it against ADCs who harass you from long range or chase you down (Zeri).
threats: Engage supports who dive you before level 6.
Assassins when you don't have Astral Flight.
mistakes: Forcing early trades instead of farming stardust.
Using W to attack and having no way to escape.
Casting your ultimate without CC to guarantee it lands.

matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: She dives with her ultimate: save E and R to hold her when she arrives.
matchup_notes.Jinx: She scales too: farm and win teamfights with The Skies Descend.
matchup_notes.Ezreal: He pokes with Q: stay behind your minions, you dominate him in teamfights.
matchup_notes.Lucian: Survive the laning phase, the rest belongs to you.
matchup_notes.Zeri: She chases and pokes you: play near your support.

AurelionSol|adc.mid_game: Group with your team around dragons. Hit as many champions as possible for stardust, and set up The Skies Descend for the next fight.
AurelionSol|adc.late_game: Deal area damage behind your frontline: E on the group, R in the middle, Q while flying with W. Keep W to escape if a diver arrives.
AurelionSol|adc.ahead: Force teamfights around objectives: The Skies Descend wreaks havoc.
AurelionSol|adc.behind: Farm and stack stardust: you keep scaling when the others have finished buying.
AurelionSol|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the laning phase, then win teamfights thanks to your stacked stardust.
AurelionSol|adc.final_tip: Every enemy you hit gives you stardust: in lane, favor safe abilities that land over risky trades.
